name: Renegades
description: Revolutionaries against the Consulate whom Yahenni aided.

description_citations.text: "Yahenni". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Baan explains that the Inventors' Fair preparations have been disrupted by vandals.
timeline.quote: preparations have been repeatedly disrupted by vandals and malcontents

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Baan recognizes Chandra's surname and reveals Pia and Kiran Nalaar were renegade luminaries.
timeline.quote: Pia and Kiran Nalaar were early luminaries of the renegade movement.

citation.text: "Homesick" by Chris L'Etoile. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Saheeli spends the night in automaton duels with the renegades at the arena.
timeline.quote: Saheeli had been automaton dueling with the renegades all through the night.

citation.text: "A Time for Innovation" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2016.

timeline.summary: Chandra resolves to find the renegade inventor she believes is in danger, though the Gatewatch does not care.
timeline.quote: Somewhere in this crowd was the renegade she sought

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana and Chandra's search turns into mingling with inventors and dancing.
timeline.quote: Chandra's and Liliana's search for the renegade had become a series of chats with renegade sympathizers

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: The hooded man shows a Leaking Spire symbol to renegade inventors and steals a listener module from an automaton.
timeline.quote: The little metallic listener module obeyed his commands, prying itself out of her device.

citation.text: "Torch of Defiance" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Years later, Pia has rallied a contingent of inventors and citizens as the renegades against the Consulate's grip on aether.
timeline.quote: Pia had rallied a growing contingent of inventors, tinkers, artists

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Pia rallies the renegades, listing grievances about the Consulate taking their aether, before the display.
timeline.quote: Let us be as proud, unafraid, unyielding as those who believe they can extinguish our spirits!

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: The renegades launch nearly a hundred thopters that form a glittering column over the fairgrounds.
timeline.quote: The machines dove through the air to opposite ends of the plaza, nearly a hundred in number.

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: The thopters change colors and form the leaking spire symbol over the Fair.
timeline.quote: As the metal of the thopters heated, their colors changed through yellows to greens to rich purples and blues

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: The thopters release a pulse of aether that topples the Consulate automatons.
timeline.quote: The sudden rush of energy flooded into the identical automata, creating sparks of concentrated aether.

citation.text: "Renegade Prime" by Mel Li. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Sep 2016.

timeline.summary: Baral intends to use a device to hamper mages among the renegades.
timeline.quote: he intends to use the device to hamper the 'mages' among the ranks of the renegades

citation.text: Sphere of Resistance (Kaladesh Inventions, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: After unknown magic users save Renegade Prime from execution, the Consulate takes all unapproved inventions into custody.
timeline.quote: the Consulate issued an ordinance to all citizens of Ghirapur

citation.text: "Consulate", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Baan advises encircling the Aether Hub, identifies Chandra as the Gatewatch's weakest link, and Tezzeret orders Baral to distract her.
timeline.quote: Baan stated that the weakest link of the group was Chandra Nalaar, due to her impulsiveness.

citation.text: "Dovin Baan", section "Kaladesh". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: When the Renegades attack the Spire, Baan sabotages the Hope of Ghirapur and planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: Baan boarded the Heart of Kiran and sabotaged the Hope of Ghirapur

citation.text: "Dovin Baan", section "Kaladesh". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Renegades repeatedly disrupt the preparations for the Fair.
timeline.quote: preparations for the Fair became repeatedly disrupted by renegades.

citation.text: "Inventors' Fair", section "Crackdown on renegades". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oviya aids the Renegades in their attack on the Consulate's Spire.
timeline.quote: Oviya later aided the Renegades in their attack on the Consulate's Spire .

citation.text: "Oviya Pashiri", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The renegades attacked the Aether Hub and its personnel yielded.
timeline.quote: the renegades attacked the Aether Hub .

citation.text: "Pia Nalaar", section "Renegade Prime". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Shadowblayde takes part in the Renegades' attack on the Consulate's Spire.
timeline.quote: Shadowblayde was part of the Renegades' attack on the Consulate's Spire.

citation.text: "Vatti", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret claims the confiscations are safeguarding the inventions from renegade attack.
timeline.quote: It's not as though we're stealing their inventions. We're safeguarding them.

citation.text: "A Grateful Consulate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Baan plans curfews and tighter aether supply to suppress the renegades while the Gatewatch is captured.
timeline.quote: Increased Bastion presence. Curfews, perhaps.

citation.text: "A Grateful Consulate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: The renegades come to defy the Consulate, believing it conceals information and oppresses the public.
timeline.quote: These renegades defy the Consulate as they attempt to restore the independence they believe they deserve.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Kaladesh" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Yahenni finds Nived painting the renegade leaking spire over torn Consulate banners at the Museum of Invention.
timeline.quote: From across the street I can make out a human figure putting the final touches on their graffiti.

citation.text: "In the Dead of Night" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Gonti reveals the renegades' safe house in the Statuary Garden and tasks Yahenni with warning them that the Consulate is coming, to force them into acting.
timeline.quote: You'll find the younger Nalaar and her associates in a safe house within the Statuary Garden.

citation.text: "In the Dead of Night" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Pia proposes the renegades capture the Aether Hub to cut power to the Spire, and reveals they have a big invention only needing aether.
timeline.quote: "We take the Aether Hub."

citation.text: "Quiet Moments" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Dec 2016.

timeline.summary: Rashmi realizes Saheeli knew the transporter's implications and senses the planeswalker nature in her; Saheeli welcomes her to the renegade movement.
timeline.quote: "Welcome to the renegade movement, my friend. I have much to tell you."

citation.text: "Breakthrough" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Dec 2016.

timeline.summary: The crowd erupts into angry complaints about what the Consulate took from them, nearly becoming a riot.
timeline.quote: The spark had caught quickly, and within minutes; the club threatened to become a riot

authors: Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines
citation.text: "Revolution Begins" by Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Sram orders a full lockdown and then shuts down the pumps, guessing the renegades jammed the shutoffs open.
timeline.quote: "Kill the pumps. Now!"

authors: Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines
citation.text: "Revolution Begins" by Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: The renegades storm the Hub by gondola and breach the security doors, killing Kailash and defeating her troops.
timeline.quote: Kailash and her troops went down fighting.

authors: Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines
citation.text: "Revolution Begins" by Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: The renegades return victorious; Pia announces the Hub is won and calls on them to bring down Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: "We've won the day!" Pia cried to more cheers.

authors: Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines
citation.text: "Revolution Begins" by Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Pia's team meets Mrs. Pashiri, who gives them a crate containing a weapon against the turret, and brings renegade inventors.
timeline.quote: "A weapon against the Consulate," Mrs. Pashiri said.

citation.text: "Breaking Points" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: The ground team fights through automata and peacewalkers around the turret; Shadowblayde is caught in a peacewalker's treads.
timeline.quote: She lost her footing and fell sideways, dragged toward the spikes as she struggled to release herself.

citation.text: "Breaking Points" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: The renegades release dozens of gremlins that devour the turret's aether and disable it.
timeline.quote: Torn open and drained, the turret went dark and the cannon sagged, aetherless and useless.

citation.text: "Breaking Points" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Renegade forces closed in on the Aether Spire as Consulate blockades failed one by one.
timeline.quote: As renegade forces closed in on the Aether Spire, Consulate blockades failed one by one.

citation.text: Dispersal Technician (Aether Revolt, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Derby Crows joined the renegades in open revolt.
timeline.quote: were quick to join the renegades in open revolt

citation.text: Leave in the Dust (Aether Revolt, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Wind-Kin aeronauts sided with the renegades.
timeline.quote: Small aeronaut societies like the Wind-Kin had little to lose by siding with the renegades

citation.text: Wind-Kin Raiders (Aether Revolt, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The renegades mounted an aether disruptor aboard a thopter to destroy Tezzeret's Planar Bridge.
timeline.quote: The renegades mounted an aether disruptor aboard a lightweight thopter to destroy Tezzeret's Planar Bridge.

citation.text: Hope of Ghirapur (Aether Revolt, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Renegades salvaged the shattered gearhulk to the renegade foundry.
timeline.quote: When the salvage team brought in the shattered gearhulk, a wave of excitement swept through the renegade foundry.

citation.text: Resourceful Return (Aether Revolt, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Fighting spilled over into Giant's Walk, angering the normally placid giants.
timeline.quote: When fighting spilled over into Giant's Walk, the aether weapons and swooping airships angered the normally placid creatures.

citation.text: Enraged Giant (Aether Revolt, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Venkat Dasai rallies renegades to give the Consulate a taste of its own medicine.
timeline.quote: The Consulate sought to crush us. Let's give them a taste of their own medicine.

citation.text: Barricade Breaker (Aether Revolt, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Led by Pia Nalaar, the Renegades revolt and seize large parts of Ghirapur to overthrow the Consulate.
timeline.quote: the Renegades have seized control of large portions of Ghirapur

citation.text: "Aether Revolt", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch and Ajani support the Renegades while searching for Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: The Gatewatch and Ajani Goldmane support the renegades

citation.text: "Aether Revolt", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Grand Exhibition at the Inventors' Fair ends in stolen inventions, abducted inventors and violence, fracturing the Consulate and citizens and sparking revolt.
timeline.quote: inventions were stolen, inventors abducted, and violence threatened the crowds at the arena

citation.text: "Aether Revolt (event)", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Renegades swell in number and arm themselves with quicksmith armor, plated airships and raided aether.
timeline.quote: the Renegades saw their ranks swelling in the wake of the Inventors' Fair

citation.text: "Aether Revolt (event)", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch plans with renegades to take over the Aether Hub to fuel an airship and hinder Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: They started planning a takeover of the hub

citation.text: "Aether Revolt (event)", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The renegades attack the Aether Spire in three teams, but Dovin Baan disables the disruptor and Baral dispels Jace's illusions; Pia's gremlins disable the cannon.
timeline.quote: Dovin Baan had secretly stowed away aboard the Heart of Kiran and managed to disable the aether disruptor

citation.text: "Aether Revolt (event)", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The renegades attack the Aether Hub and begin a revolt; the Consulate diverts the Gatewatch with Baral and Dovin Baan and retakes the hub.
timeline.quote: the Consulate retook control of the Aether Hub

citation.text: "Consulate", section "Aether Revolt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Tezzeret's final defeat, the Consulate yields to the Renegades and Pia Nalaar is named consul of Allocation.
timeline.quote: Pia Nalaar was named as the new consul of Allocation.

citation.text: "Consulate", section "Aether Revolt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Tezzeret's coup, Saheeli joins the Renegades and Gatewatch and, with Liliana, breaks into the Aether Spire, finding Rashmi gone and the invention rebuilt.
timeline.quote: Saheeli joined forces with the Renegades and the newly arrived Gatewatch .

citation.text: "Saheeli Rai", section "Renegade". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

era.label: March of the Machine: The Aftermath

timeline.summary: The Indigo Revolution removes the Consulate; the Avishkar Assembly is installed and renames the plane Avishkar.
timeline.quote: the Consulate was removed from power in the Indigo Revolution

citation.text: "Consulate", section "Rebuilding and the Indigo Revolution". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The renegades captured the Hub with the Gatewatch's help and redirected its aether to their airship.
timeline.quote: capturing it with help from the Gatewatch

citation.text: "Aether Hub", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Consulate retook the Hub and the renegades fled aboard their airship.
timeline.quote: the renegades fled aboard their newly completed airship

citation.text: "Aether Hub", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The renegades and the Gatewatch cut off Tezzeret's aether; seizure of the Aether Hub failed to permanently disrupt him.
timeline.quote: After an initial seizure of the Aether Hub failed to permanently disrupt Tezzeret's access

citation.text: "Aether Spire", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The renegades assaulted the Aether Spire with the Heart of Kiran and a fleet.
timeline.quote: the renegades staged a direct assault on the Aether Spire itself.

citation.text: "Aether Spire", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The rebel Renegades thwart the Consulate's plan, clearing the way for Avishkar's new beginnings.
timeline.quote: Their plan was thwarted by a rebel group known as the Renegades

citation.text: "Avishkar". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The NCC with former Renegades and allies coordinated a nearly bloodless coup that removed the Consulate, organized and led by Pia Nalaar.
timeline.quote: coordinated a nearly bloodless coup that removed the Consulate from power

citation.text: "Indigo Revolution", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Aether Revolt Rashmi sabotages her invention and is rescued by Saheeli and the Renegades.
timeline.quote: Rashmi ultimately sabotaged her invention

citation.text: "Rashmi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rashmi and Mitul join the Renegades and complete a skyship Rashmi renames the Heart of Kiran.
timeline.quote: which she renamed the

citation.text: "Rashmi", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sram and his team work tirelessly to repair Ghirapur after the Renegades' destruction.
timeline.quote: Sram and his team worked tirelessly to repair the city.

citation.text: "Sram". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Venkat contacts radical renegades and organizes the sabotage and supply raids that made Pia and her fellow resisters infamous.
timeline.quote: started using his military training to organize the sabotage and supply raids

citation.text: "Venkat Dasai", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Facing the end of their life, Yahenni absorbs the energy of Consulate enforcers and aligns with the Renegades.
timeline.quote: Yahenni chose to extend their life by absorbing the energy of a few of them

citation.text: "Yahenni", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
